item.title: The Lowest Temperature in Bangladesh was recorded at 8.4°C in Chuadanga today

item.title: Indian bride rejects Groom for not knowing "Basic Math"
item.description: In India, a bride canceled her wedding after learning that her fiancé had failed a math proficiency test. After the groom miscounted a few notes of Rs. 10, Rita Singh of Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh, called off her wedding.The event took place after the officiating priest notified the girl's family about the groom's behavior.
